_comment: Local subset of MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise (technique ids and names as published by MITRE). submit_findings only accepts these ids. requires_event_types: a technique is only accepted if at least one cited ref is a search_logs event of one of these types (evidence-grounded mapping). brute_force: also needs at least BRUTE_FORCE_MIN (10) failed logins for the account or from the source in this run's correlation. adversary_login: a cited successful login must come from a source outside the account's baseline (usual IPs + earlier logins). requires_internal_source: T1021.004 is lateral movement (host to host inside the network); a login from an external address with valid credentials is T1078 (and T1133 for an internet-facing service).
